pages.text: Ice and Fire integration, helmets only. Press the Tinkers helmet interaction key to project; press again to return. Lasts 30 seconds per level, up to 90 seconds.

Fly through blocks other than bedrock. Interact, fight, mine and build with your own inventory and permissions. Hostiles can still target you; your armor and toughness do not reduce hits while projected.

Level I costs one ability slot: one pixie wing item, one ghost ingot and one ectoplasm. Level II: two ingots and three ectoplasm. Level III: three ingots, one ectoplasm and one pixie dust. Levels II and III cost no additional slots.
